text: Hello, I'm fostering a 4 month old girl who has chickenpox. Spots are itchy, she's rubbing at them, but otherwise she seems well I think. She's got a mild cough too, nothing major as far as I can tell. Feeding normaly, taking her bottles as usual. Just wondering if theres anything I can safley put on the spots at her age, or if I should be doing anything diffrent.
